fixes: Libraries keep the same bottom navigation policy; active readers hide it.
Result actions target the real profile/review/shop tab rather than a duplicate pushed root. Review exits also return to the review tab after entering directly from a lesson result.
Pinned actions respect the keyboard, content insets and home indicator.
Dialogs block underlying navigation and actions.
Seven calendar columns adapt to the available width on small screens.
Sharing cards use the accepted light palette; purchase/sharing previews show their complete contents.
One heart sheet serves the home and book paths.

tests.note: Earlier chest audit failures were caused by an insufficient progress fixture and a swipe that skipped the chest. The fixture now completes real bundled lessons through the first chest and the test scrolls using its actual bounds; it passes on both phones. No unresolved failing case remains.

limitations: Simulator verification; real-device haptics, microphone permissions, background audio and older iOS versions remain outside this run.
Official chinese-g1up and g1up-2026 resource bundles are installed and exercised. Other books are not all individually played through.
Rare restore/gift/milestone variants share the reviewed components; they are not presented as individually captured screens.
